subject.title: fix(ui): send approvals past busy chat queue

question: Should maintainers land this narrow Control UI approval-bypass after current-head gates finish, and should the release-owned CHANGELOG entry be dropped during landing?
rationale: The code path looks correct, but the protected `maintainer` label, current-head validation drift, and explicit CHANGELOG policy are human land-flow choices rather than cleanup-close or autonomous-repair decisions.

options.title: Land Narrow Fix After Gates
options.body: Land the UI and test changes after exact-head checks finish, carrying release-note context from the PR body or squash message instead of the changelog line.

options.title: Accept Changelog Exception
options.body: Land as-is if maintainers intentionally want this release-owned changelog entry on the branch before release generation.

options.title: Wait For Live Exec Proof
options.body: Pause if maintainers require credentialed live exec approval proof beyond the browser/WebSocket routing evidence and source audit.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Fix After Gates
recommendation.body: Land the UI and test changes after exact-head checks finish, carrying release-note context from the PR body or squash message instead of the changelog line.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is tied to the current-main chat-send history and owns the live branch context for this maintainer-labeled PR.
